reason: This plugin is primarily an agent-workflow orchestration extension that adds a Deep Design preset plus design-principles and QA skill packs to run a local, iterative design process with render-based critique and session memory, as evidenced by its README and package manifest.

summaries.zh: Deep Design 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供“Deep Design”设计模式与规则、质检技能包，帮助你在本地按迭代闭环流程生成与改进设计结果。
summaries.en: Deep Design is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a Deep Design mode and design-principles/QA skill packs to support iterative local design workflows with render-and-review feedback.

capabilities: Automates and orchestrates an iterative design workflow inside a DeepSeek Harness agent preset
Provides reusable design-principles and visual QA skill packs
Uses headless rendering for desktop/mobile artifact review
Enables optional web research through configured fetch/web provider
Persists and reuses design context in workspace `.design/` files

reasons.code: Readme describes a persistent design loop with brief, render, critic pass, fix, and re-render steps, indicating process automation and orchestration
Readme states web research is enabled (`fetch: true`) for preset sessions, implying external network access depending on configured provider
Readme states the plugin records and reads `.design/` state in the workspace across sessions, indicating filesystem read/write context persistence
